name: Mocorp Custom Metal Fabrication
old_description: MOCORP specializes in building components of all sizes and quantities for original equipment manufacturers in several automation industries. Our focus is on precision, quality and providing the type of finish needed to complete your project.
about:
Mocorp Custom Metal Fabrication operates from Ramsey, Minnesota, delivering custom commercial metal fabrication and welding services. The company serves original equipment manufacturers across automation industries as well as clients in retail, hospitality, and restaurant sectors.

Its shop provides bending capacity up to 168 inches in length with 350-ton presses, rolling up to 96 inches with a maximum sheet thickness of 1/2-inch plate, and recently added CNC machining to complement its fabrication and welding offerings. On-site services are also available for installation and support.

Customers include OEMs in automation, as well as businesses in architectural metalwork, process systems, retail fixtures, hospitality, and restaurant equipment. The company emphasizes long-term relationships, with many clients returning for multiple projects over years.

Mocorp differentiates itself through responsive quoting powered by current software, a focus on meeting customer lead-time requirements through collaborative planning, and a commitment to delivering quality products at competitive prices. The team describes its approach as nimble, knowledgeable, and passionate about each project.
